title: Argentinian Gyoza Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry using Asian-style gyoza and Argentinian bok choi, perfect for a gluten-free meal.

ingredients.name: Gyoza
ingredients.notes: Pan-fry before adding to stir fry

instructions: 1. Heat 1 tbsp of jammy sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Pan-fry the gyoza until lightly browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
3. Remove the gyoza from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the remaining 1 tbsp of jammy sesame oil to the skillet and stir-fry the separated bok choi florets until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Return the pan-fried gyoza to the skillet and stir-fry for another minute.
6. Add the light soy sauce and stir to combine.
